title: Snack Time with Snorlax
description: Settle down and enjoy a cozy slice of life with your Cobblemon, or build an airship and go adventuring. Take things at your own pace and have fun. :)
body:
Snack Time with Snorlax

Settle down and enjoy a slice of life with your Cobblemon, build an industrial empire with Create or just craft an airship and go adventuring with Create Aeronautics. Whatever you decide to do, take things at your own pace and have fun. :)

‎ ![A field of green grass and trees lays before you and in the distance lies beautiful mountainous terrain with a river at the base leading into a cavern that stretches beneath the mountain.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8291f4578ba6a57ba880ac01c73d57a5cd7cc23_0.webp) My aim with this modpack is to curate a set of mods that compliment each other and extend the world and mechanics of Minecraft in a variety of directions. It has a full range of mods that enhance performance, add new creatures, farming and cooking mechanics, furniture, magic, archaeology, storage tech, biomes, enhanced worldgen, quality of life features and more.

🌍Worldgen & Effects:

- [Geophilic](https://modrinth.com/mod/geophilic) - [Nature's Spirit](https://modrinth.com/mod/natures-spirit) - [Sparse Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/sparsestructures) - [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/mod/tectonic) - [William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld](https://modrinth.com/mod/wwoo)

⚒️Building & Crafting:

- [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries), [Amendments](https://modrinth.com/mod/amendments) + [Supplementaries Squared](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries-squared) - [Another Furniture](https://modrinth.com/mod/another-furniture) - [NeoContinuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/neocontinuity) - [Vista](https://modrinth.com/mod/vista_tv), [Vista - All the Cassettes!](https://modrinth.com/mod/vista-all-the-cassettes) + [Glaiden's Vista Improvements](https://modrinth.com/mod/glaidens-vista-improvements)

- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) - [Create: Aquatic Ambitions](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aquatic-ambitions) - [Create Big Cannons](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons) + [Create Big Cannons: Advanced Technologies](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-big-cannons-advanced-technologies) - [Create: Bits 'n' Bobs](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bits-n-bobs) - [Create: Connected](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-connected) - [Create Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition) - [Create Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco) - [Create: Diesel Generators](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-diesel-generators) - [Create: Dreams & Desires](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-dreams-and-desires) - [Create: Enchantment Industry](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-enchantment-industry) - [Create: Movable Tracks](https://modrinth.com/mod/movable-tracks) - [Create Optical](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-optical) - [Create: Solar Powered](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-solar-powered) - [Steam 'n' Rails Neoforge](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails-1.21.1)

- [Sophisticated Backpacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks) + [Sophisticated Backpacks Create Integration](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-backpacks-create-integration) - [Sophisticated Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage) + [Sophisticated Storage Create Integration](https://modrinth.com/mod/sophisticated-storage-create-integration)

❤️QoL & Social:

- [Appleskin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) - [Analog Audio](https://modrinth.com/mod/analog-audio) - [Cherished Worlds](https://modrinth.com/mod/cherished-worlds) - [Client Sort](https://modrinth.com/mod/clientsort) - [Discord & Chat Images](https://modrinth.com/mod/discord-chat-connect) - [Emojiful](https://modrinth.com/mod/emojiful) - [Fixed Anvil Repair Cost](https://modrinth.com/mod/fixed-anvil-repair-cost) - [In Control!](https://modrinth.com/mod/in-control) - [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) + Several Addons - [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) - [Lootr](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootr) + [Lootrmon](https://modrinth.com/mod/lootrmon) - [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) - [Overflowing Bars](https://modrinth.com/mod/overflowing-bars) - [Open Parties and Claims](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-parties-and-claims) - [Ping Wheel](https://modrinth.com/mod/ping-wheel) - [Scholar](https://modrinth.com/mod/scholar) - [Searchables](https://modrinth.com/mod/searchables) - [Starter Kit](https://modrinth.com/mod/starter-kit) - [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap) + [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) - [You're In Grave Danger](https://modrinth.com/mod/yigd)

🖥️Performance:

- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) + [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) - [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) - [Chloride](https://modrinth.com/mod/chloride) - [C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-neoforge) - [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) - [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix) - [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) - [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) - [Let Me Despawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/lmd) - [Krypton Reno](https://modrinth.com/mod/krypton-fnp) - [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) Some of those mods could even fit into several different categories. There are probably some mods that I've forgotten to list here so take a look through what's included and hopefully you'll find it to be an enjoyable modpack. :) You should try this modpack with [Voxy](https://github.com/j-shelfwood/voxy-neoforge) too! It's pretty cool. If you build the version linked here and add it to your pack it should work well. I've been using  it for a while now with great results. I can see blocks that are thousands of blocks away with it. :)
